integrity: The original \([24,4,16]_5\) trace code is independently reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_{25}\), and its published ordinary enumerator is reproduced exactly. Puncturing and shortening then reproduce both published companion enumerators. All message subspaces are exhaustively enumerated in RREF to obtain the complete higher-support spectra.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support census for the \(q=5\) punctured and shortened codes in Example 2(b). It does not give an all-\(q\) SSWD formula, and equivalent presentations in broad older coding literature remain a residual novelty risk.
title: Complete higher-support profiles of the \(q=5\) punctured and shortened two-zero codes
